name: Board Sovereign Qellan Vyss
role: Chairman of the Zyphari Compact Governing Board
notes: Entity record created 2026-08-09 to close a structural gap: this character existed ONLY as a charforge capsule, with no entity record, while being referenced by entity records (e.g. vessel crew_ids / commanding_officer_id). It therefore dangled from the entity graph and was silently omitted by every tool that indexes entity records. Core fields derive from the capsule, which is the authoritative existing canon; nothing was invented.

naming_exemption.reason: Name preserved verbatim from the committed charforge capsule (canon/L2/entities/qellan_vyss/capsule/identity.json).

capsule_binding_note: Explicit bridge between the two identifier namespaces. Relational fields across canon (crew_ids, commanding_officer_id, task_group_commander_id) refer to this entity by its CAPSULE id "qellan_vyss", while the record identity is "char_qellan_vyss". Before this field the two were connected only by stripping a prefix and hoping; tools/canon_reference_integrity.py now checks the bridge instead of guessing it.
